question: How can I configure Claude or Slack so that it doesn't add "Sent using @Claude" when sending a message on Slack using Claude Desktop?
answer: It appears that there is currently no official setting or configuration in Claude Desktop or Slack to remove the footer 'Sent using @Claude' (or 'Sent using Claude').
